scope: heaptrack whole command, including corpus construction, correctness gates, setup and teardown; instrumented elapsed time is not latency evidence
hypothesis: BoundedVecWriter exact per-chunk reservations dominate cumulative requested allocation bytes; successful realloc records count the entire requested new size, not physical copies
decision: Attribute retained stacks before modifying production. Preserve output bytes, typed allocation errors, finite output bounds and exact-source authorization. Any candidate requires separate matched validation and resource measurement.
isolation: one task CPU workload at a time; shared KVM background uncontrolled
trace_analysis: heaptrack_print --merge-backtraces 0; cumulative requested volume must not be called physical copies or resident memory
